surprises: IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W311-S1: The complete-day drop can remove a trading day's row and its ABSENT record at the edge of the feed, because adapt() takes its domain from the kept rows; kept as written (ARMED, disarm owner 2.0.0_SA_COO~I2).

IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W311-S4: A duplicate or non-canonical dimension key collapses silently in the account map, the later one winning.
